items.title: Clamped E3 committed-selection variance-MONOPOLY PRESENCE audit in V3-EXQ-571's own config (clamp OFF vs ON, matched seeds)
items.note: MONOPOLY-PRESENCE AUDIT, ratified 2026-08-30 governance (REE_assembly 54dbe477be) off confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-936a_2026-08-30 (b0c0b8df72) Section 8. GATES THE 936 FAMILY: a further 936-family falsifier is REFUSED until a monopoly-present regime is established. MECH-439's 0.886 premise comes from V3-EXQ-571 ARM_0 (2026-05-15/16), which ran BEFORE the E2 rollout clamp landed (ree-v3 d327b89, 2026-05-31) and with the flag at its default False; 936a then measured the inverse (residue ~99.9998%, F 6.33e-06) but in a DIFFERENT config, so neither run separates 'the clamp did it' from 'three months of substrate drift did it'. This makes the clamp a WITHIN-RUN, WITHIN-CONFIG manipulation (571's own config, clamp OFF vs ON, matched seeds), which a clamp-ON-only re-run could not do. Ha -> premise collapses, governance re-words; Hb -> MECH-439 is regime-scoped and the falsifier is re-posed THERE with a monopoly-presence precondition and a relative bar. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = per-channel committed-selection variance share in 571's config with the clamp armed. reanalysis_query over evidence/experiments found f_variance_share carried ONLY by v3_exq_936/936a (substrate_hash 8a497aea/2151a114, both the GAP-A stack, not 571's config); 571's own manifests predate substrate_hash entirely (UNVERIFIABLE) and are unclamped. Not recoverable -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-439 counts 13 ceiling autopsies, but this is a DIAGNOSTIC on the MEASUREMENT axis, which the 936a autopsy Section 8 explicitly exempted ('the successor is on the measurement axis, not another letter of the braked design'). No ceiling hit added. Carrying forward that autopsy's unresolved 9-vs-12 brake-count reconcile for GOV-APPLY-1 rather than silently picking a number -- it does not affect this reading either way. STEP 2.5c: open corrupting substrate_queue entries contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy and SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training overlap paths this driver exercises; both are fix-landed-pending-validation and both bear on representation/rollout QUALITY, whereas this readout is a channel-SCALE property of the score sum. Recorded as known limitations, not blocking. The other corrupting entries are unreachable here: use_lateral_pfc_analog / use_salience_coordinator / use_blocked_agency are all config-default False and this driver enables none of them. THREE PREDECESSOR INSTRUMENT DEFECTS FIXED, each confirmed against source not inferred: (1) 571 read the E3 decomp once per ENV STEP while e3_steps_per_tick defaults to 10 and the last_* attributes LATCH, so its ~200 rows sat behind ~20 real selections -- measured replication_factor 7.06 here; this driver latch-gates via _lib/fresh_select and records n_latched. (2) 571's component list (inherited by 936/936a) summed the RAW unweighted `f`, but the score is f_weight*f + lambda_eff*m + rho_residue*phi (e3_selector.py:1310), so the additive F term is `f_weighted`; harmless at the default f_weight=1.0 but silently wrong otherwise -- both component sets are now decomposed and recorded. (3) 936a's prescribed scale anchors were never implemented, leaving 'naturally sub-ceiling vs clamp-PINNED' unanswerable; measured read-only here off the committed rollout. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, mandatory): DV is variance SHARES, whose symmetry group is per-channel additive constants, selection-index permutation, and a COMMON positive rescaling. A0/A1 (load-bearing CLAMP contrast) is NOT invariant -- the clamp bounds ||z_world|| along the rollout, rescaling the f/residue path non-uniformly, i.e. changing the RATIO of per-channel variances, and it demonstrably binds (smoke: max||z_w||/ceiling 183.2 unclamped vs exactly 1.0000 clamped). A2/A3 (secondary STACK contrast) reaches the DV only INDIRECTLY and is explicitly NOT load-bearing: the stack's bias is composed into score_bias at the select() call site, outside score_trajectory (e3_selector.py:1288-1296), benefit/novelty/goal_weighted are hardcoded 0.0 in the component dict, and a probe found last_channel_terms carrying a single score_bias entry with per-candidate range 0.0 -- a BROADCAST SCALAR, argmin-invariant by construction. No verdict routes on those arms. SMOKE: PASS end-to-end (8 cells), and it earned its keep -- it caught TWO defects before any compute. (a) the 571/936a pool share method divides by variance-of-the-SUM (covariance retained), so an anti-correlated pair drives the 'share' ABOVE 1.0 -- observed at 1.06 and 2.15 -- making '>=0.85' not a monopoly test; C1 now routes on the committed partition (sum-of-variances denominator, bounded [0,1]) with the pool figures still recorded and each >1 cell flagged. (b) the clamp anchor originally tested 'norm >= ceiling', which is TRUE both when a clamped rollout is pinned AT the ceiling and when an unclamped one EXCEEDS it -- it read 0.9667 on BOTH arms at seed 42, invariant under its own manipulation; split into at_ceiling / above_ceiling / max_over_ceiling, which now separate the arms cleanly. red-team (opus-5, SAME-MODEL not cross-model -- fable pass was launched but returned no verdict, so this was re-run in-session per the skill's fallback): CONTESTED, 3 findings, all dispositioned. F1 FIXED: the readiness gate took the worst cell across ALL four arms while only A0/A1 route the verdict, so a secondary div-stack cell under-sampling would have vacated a clean load-bearing result -- the V3-EXQ-785 whole-run-AND defect; preconditions are now scoped to the verdict-bearing arms and the secondary arms' readiness is recorded as a non-gating diagnostic. F2 FIXED: C1^C2^C3 all true collapsed to label 'f_monopoly_regime_present_clamped' while the smoke shows the occupant SHIFTING within F (f_weighted -> harm_weighted), hiding the shift from governance; added the distinct label f_monopoly_present_clamped_occupant_shifted. F3 RECORDED-NOT-FIXED: the routed committed partition and 571's covariance-retained 0.886 are different statistics and the 0.85 bar was calibrated in 571's world -- the bar is deliberately left where 936a set it rather than re-derived, because moving a pre-registered threshold to fit a new statistic would fabricate it; compare 0.886 against legacy571_pool_top_share, never against C1 (stated in manifest diagnostics.share_method_note).
